name: Author monthly
description: Never-expiring repositories while subscribed, then a 90-day grace period. Renews monthly. Cancel renewal at any time.

name: Author annual
description: Never-expiring repositories while subscribed, then a 90-day grace period. Renews annually. Cancel renewal at any time.

name: Live updates
description: Automatic updates for one repository for 180 days, with its own storage allowance. No automatic renewal.

name: Extended expiration
description: Keep one repository online for up to one more year. Buy again to add another year. No automatic renewal.

name: Never expire
description: One repository never expires. One-time payment, no subscription.

name: Extra repository
description: Host one more repository beyond the free allowance, with its own storage. It does not count toward your free repositories. One-time payment, valid while the repository exists.

name: Paper pack
description: Everything one paper needs during review: an extra repository, automatic updates for 180 days, and one more year before it expires. One-time payment.

name: Workshop
description: For a workshop or small venue. A review window of up to 180 days. No automatic renewal.

name: Conference
description: For a typical conference track. A review window of up to 180 days. No automatic renewal.

name: Large conference
description: For a large venue with several tracks. A review window of up to 180 days. No automatic renewal.
